card.name: Lead-in to infectious disease names
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "as", "from" or "to", commas, and the first piece of a disease name, in lists of infectious diseases ("diseases such as measles, mumps, cholera"). It fires just before the next disease name is expected.

modes.label: After "diseases such"
modes.description: The word "as" introduces a list of infectious diseases.
modes.example: combat water-borne diseases such<< as>> cholera and typhoid.

modes.label: Within a disease list
modes.description: A comma or the start of a disease name inside a list of vaccine-preventable or contagious diseases.
modes.example: effects of diseases such as measles<<,>> diphtheria or polio.

modes.label: Cause of death or illness
modes.description: A linking word such as "from" or "to" before a named infectious disease.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward starting infectious disease names, such as typhoid, tetanus, typhus and tuberculosis, which begin with ty, tub or pol.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a sentence where a named infectious disease, like measles or cholera, is about to come up.
